name: Scudding Tsuba
description: Draws the lead foot back one stride while the blade covers the retreat line, made on a rising breath.

name: Tsubathwack
description: Slides the edge forward along the target while stepping in, slicing through the exposed arm.

name: Tsukabarrier
description: Wipes the blade across the opponent's cut while stepping off to the side, turning the force away, finished with a clean recovery.

name: Menukithwack
description: Cuts up a diagonal from the hip into the opponent's knee with the edge, finishing with the point on the centerline.

name: Prowling Tsuka
description: Moves off line in a quick, low step that leaves the opponent's cut meeting empty air.

name: Habakiswat
description: Chains a rising, a level and a falling cut without pausing between strokes.

name: Grim Kiri
description: Drives the point straight at the throat or chest, pushing off the rear foot.

name: Rigid Hamon
description: Braces the blade with both hands and a wide stance to hold against a heavy downward cut, made on a rising breath.

name: Raw Noto
description: Cuts downward from above the head into the opponent's flank with the edge, with the rear foot driving the cut through.

name: Nukitsuke Barrier
description: Thumps the pommel into the opponent's wrist to break their grip at close range, made on a rising breath.

name: Menukibandage
description: Judges the opponent's reach from the line of their shoulders and feet before committing to a step, kept close to the body.

name: Tsukaslap
description: Alternates cuts and thrusts in steady rhythm to drive the opponent backward and deny them room to counter.

name: Sageo Carapace
description: Deflects a cut while stepping outside its line, ending on the opponent's open side.

name: Dense Mune
description: Lifts the sword overhead at an angle so a descending cut slides along the blade, kept close to the body.

name: Harsh Zanshin

name: Menukibuckle

name: Hungry Tameshi

name: Stalwart Menuki

name: Stalling Nakago

name: Notoswat

name: Munelinen

name: Menukislap

name: Nakagoprop

name: Tsubabarrier
